title: Splitting a bill loses cents
prompt:
Splitting a 100.00 bill among 3 people gives 33.33 each and one cent disappears. `split(total, n)` in app/money.py
must return `n` amounts as `Decimal` with 2 decimal places that add up exactly to `total`; the extra cents go to the
first people (100.00 / 3 → 33.34, 33.33, 33.33). `total` may be a str, int or Decimal (never float); `n` must be ≥ 1
and a negative total raises `ValueError`.
